# OMEGA 4-Tier Multi-Scale Observatory (v6.8.0)

> Zero-dependency Node.js ESM, Python 3, and WebGL 2.0 local cockpit supervising 8 live Artificial Life endpoints across 7 public repositories on 127.0.0.1:8790 with render-only D7RO observer isolation (verified by display-matrix assertions, #ifdef PICK checks, and a live loopback wire-spy test), loopback HTTP CSRF & live raw-socket WebSocket Upgrade 403 CSWSH defenses, offline-engine DEGRADED conservation gating, bounded bare-metal 1..1,000,000 controls differentially verified on 18 raw unnormalized inputs between Node and Python, and 9/9 hand-planted regression mutants killed (7 in lib/observatory_core.mjs, 2 in server.mjs).
